model.name: left-censored log-linear growth on log10 parasites/mL
model.formula: log10(P(t)) = a + b t; observed ND values are left-censored at 10 parasites/mL
model.observation_model: Gaussian errors on log10 scale; detected values use a normal density and ND measurements use the normal CDF below the 10 parasites/mL detection limit

diagnostics.baseline_comparison: Quadratic time curvature did not improve AIC (ΔAIC=-2.00), so the free-intercept log-linear model was retained. It gives a daily log10 growth rate of 0.400 and 48 h multiplication factor 6.30; the fitted residual SD is 0.22 log10 units.
